gloss: to serve as, to fill a role

definitions.gloss: to serve as, to fill the role of
definitions.explanation: To take on and carry out a particular role, duty, or responsibility.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{委員長|いいんちょう}を{務|つと}めている。
examples.english: He serves as the committee chair.

examples.japanese: {主役|しゅやく}を{務|つと}めるのは{初|はじ}めてで、とても{緊張|きんちょう}した。
examples.english: It was my first time playing the lead role, and I was very nervous.

notes:
{務|つと}める means to fulfill a role or duty.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})
- Pattern: 〜を{務|つと}める (to serve as ~)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {司会|しかい}を{務|つと}める: to serve as MC
- {役|やく}を{務|つと}める: to play a role
- {委員長|いいんちょう}を{務|つと}める: to serve as chair
- {責任者|せきにんしゃ}を{務|つと}める: to serve as the person in charge

SIMILAR WORDS (same reading, different kanji):
- {務|つと}める: to serve as, to fill a role
- {勤|つと}める: to work at, to be employed
- {努|つと}める: to make an effort
